dropallplus.button.tooltip:
Drops your whole inventory and hotbar.
Armor and locked slots stay.
dropallplus.menu.show_button.tooltip: Shows the Drop All button in every screen with your inventory: inventory, chests, shulker boxes, furnaces, server menus like /shop. The gear for this menu stays even without the button.
dropallplus.menu.button_position.tooltip: Where the button sits. If it doesn't fit below, for example a large chest in a small window, it moves to the right automatically.
dropallplus.menu.drop_key.tooltip: Drops your inventory with one key press, in game and in every screen. Click, then press the key. Esc clears the binding. Also under Options, Controls, Key Binds, Drop All.
dropallplus.menu.confirm.tooltip: Safety check: the Drop All key has to be pressed twice within 1.5 seconds. Prevents accidents in a fight. The button always drops right away.
dropallplus.menu.lock_key.tooltip: Hover over a slot in your inventory and press this key. A padlock appears and Drop All skips the slot. Press again to unlock.
dropallplus.menu.menu_key.tooltip: Opens this menu in game. In your inventory you can also use the gear next to the Drop All button.
dropallplus.menu.drop.hotbar.tooltip: The nine slots at the bottom.
dropallplus.menu.drop.offhand.tooltip: The item in your left hand, for example a shield or a totem.
dropallplus.menu.drop.armor.tooltip: Also the armor you're wearing. Only works in the normal inventory and with the key when no screen is open, because chests don't show armor slots.
dropallplus.menu.locked.tooltip: How many slots are locked right now. The lock belongs to the slot, not the item, and works on all servers and worlds.
dropallplus.menu.grid.tooltip: Click a slot to lock or unlock it. Drop All never drops locked slots, not even with the key. Top: armor, and the offhand on the right. Below that the inventory, the hotbar at the very bottom. In game, the lock key over a slot does the same.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.dropallpl: A button in every inventory screen that drops your whole inventory including the hotbar. Armor and locked slots stay.
